name: Builder {OS}
tagline: The implementation runtime: steps executed into release-ready code.

commands.name: /build
commands.does: Open the implementation runtime and preflight the session

commands.name: preflight
commands.does: Check fingerprints, working tree and open attempts without claiming

commands.name: step <id>
commands.does: Run one full step transaction from claim to done

commands.name: repair <id>
commands.does: Bounded correction against the printed evidence

commands.name: resume
commands.does: Reconcile after an interruption and continue from real state

commands.name: report
commands.does: Evidence-backed build status

commands.name: omega-builder init
commands.does: Initialise canonical Builder state

commands.name: omega-builder validate
commands.does: Validate structure and semantic invariants

commands.name: omega-builder status
commands.does: Evidence-backed status from the ledger

commands.name: omega-builder sync-step
commands.does: Import or refresh one Stepper step mirror

commands.name: omega-builder claim
commands.does: Claim a READY Stepper step

commands.name: omega-builder transition
commands.does: Apply a valid attempt transition

commands.name: omega-builder record-check
commands.does: Record deterministic check evidence

commands.name: omega-builder mark-step
commands.does: Mirror a Stepper status after an external verifier decision

commands.name: omega-builder gate
commands.does: Evaluate the build gates BG01 to BG20

commands.name: omega-builder checkpoint
commands.does: Create a recovery checkpoint

commands.name: omega-builder set-release
commands.does: Record the frozen candidate and the Stepper release result

commands.name: omega-builder release-check
commands.does: Evaluate terminal engineering readiness

commands.name: omega-builder finalize
commands.does: Create the frozen final handoff when all gates pass

commands.name: omega-builder demo
commands.does: In-memory end-to-end semantic self-test

requires_human_approval_for: any destructive or irreversible operation on a repository, database or environment
a force push, a history rewrite, or discarding uncommitted work
adding a dependency that changes the licence or supply-chain posture
writing to any production system, or using production data
accepting a step whose contract had to change to pass
finalize, which freezes the engineering handoff
